description: A waveshaper that cuts a canal out of the middle of a waveform and multiplies what is left above and below it

params.text: Applies gain to the input, -2x to 2x
Sets the centre of the canal, -2.5 to 2.5V
Sets the width of the canal, from 0V for no effect to 5V from its bottom to its top
Multiplies the part of the waveform above the canal; negative values fold that part back into the canal
Multiplies the part of the waveform below the canal; negative values fold that part back into the canal

inputs.text: Modulates the gain applied to the input
Modulates the centre of the canal
Modulates the width of the canal
Modulates the multiplier applied above the canal
Modulates the multiplier applied below the canal

outputs.text: A trigger each time the input signal crosses 0V

notes: the module shapes a signal and generates none of its own, so it does nothing until something is patched into the input
menu: Filter DC Offset switches the high pass filter that removes DC offset from the shaped output
Antialias switches the oversampling that reduces aliasing at high frequencies
CV Param Mode sets how every CV input acts on its knob: Offset adds the CV to it, Follow sets it from the CV, Attenuate scales the CV by it
CV Input Slew smooths every CV input, which stops abrupt CV changes clicking: None, 1ms, 5ms, 10ms, 25ms, 50ms or 100ms
Clamp CV Values keeps a value driven by CV inside the range of its knob; switched off, the value can go past that range
